observations: A clear plastic storage box with multiple compartments containing various metal presser feet for sewing machines.
The box is held in a hand, with a green artificial grass surface and concrete ground visible in the background.
Photo 0 shows the box open, with the lid partially visible on the right. The lid has text: 'MULTI-PURPOSE SEWING KIT 20' and a small logo with a star and sewing machine illustrations.
Photo 1 shows a closer view of the same box, focusing on the compartments. A green measuring tape is visible in the top-left compartment, wrapped in plastic.
The presser feet appear to be made of metal, mostly silver-colored, with some black plastic or rubber components.
The items are arranged in a grid of 5 columns and 4 rows, with some compartments empty or partially filled.
The text 'ABIO LAONIMACHINE' is watermarked across both photos.
No brand or model name is visible on the presser feet themselves or on the box, except for the text on the lid which is not a brand name.
